module: Entry point of the internal vehicle thumbnail generation tool. This file is a facade: it declares all the util_screenshotCreator_* submodules (ImGui interface, settings, framing, capture, batch processing job, etc.) as dependencies and delegates to them. It is used to open the tool window, start batch generation, frame a vehicle, take an off-screen capture and choose the framing mode.

dependencies.desc: List of util_screenshotCreator_* extensions loaded with this one

notes: In takeThumbnailScreenshot, the resolution, supersampling, field of view and near plane come from the util_screenshotCreator_settings settings and not from arguments.
The state.show field is not used in this file.

openWindow.desc: Opens the tool's ImGui window (delegates to util_screenshotCreator_ui.openWindow).

startWork.desc: Starts batch thumbnail generation (delegates to util_screenshotCreator_job.startWork).

workOptions.desc: Processing options (inferred from code: passed as is to the job module)

frameVehicle.desc: Computes the camera position and orientation that frame a vehicle with the procedural framing, based on the framing context from the settings.

fov.desc: Field of view in degrees (default: settings value)

resolution.desc: Resolution {width, height} used for the framing context

takeThumbnailScreenshot.desc: Takes an off-screen capture from the given camera and saves it to filepath (delegates to util_screenshotCreator_capture), with the capture parameters from the settings.

filepath.desc: Path of the image file to write

callback.desc: Called at the end of the capture

uniqueId.desc: Identifier passed to the capture module

listFramingModes.desc: Lists the available framing modes (delegates to util_screenshotCreator_framingManager.listModes).

getFramingMode.desc: Returns the identifier of the selected framing mode.

onDeserialized.desc: Hook called after an extension reload: if the data contains a UI state (windowOpen, resolutionPtr, reviewData or skipCustomCameras), passes it to util_screenshotCreator_ui.onDeserialized.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook called on unload: restores the environment modified by the settings (restoreEnvironment) and logs the unload.
